fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy the execution of malicious payloads
fields.name: Suspicious MsiExec Embedding Parent
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\powershell.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\pwsh.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\cmd.exe") and (src.process.cmdline contains "MsiExec.exe" and src.process.cmdline contains "-Embedding ")) and (not ((tgt.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "C:\\Program Files\\SplunkUniversalForwarder\\bin\\") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\DismFoDInstall.cmd" or (src.process.cmdline contains "\\MsiExec.exe -Embedding " and src.process.cmdline contains "Global\\MSI0000"))))))
